_status: Mandatory controls extracted from the five NFS policies (knowledge/). Vendor-agnostic. source_chunk_id uses the convention <doc_id>#s<section>#c1 -- confirm with the RAG engineer that ingestion produces these ids, or update them after ingestion.

controls.control: Multi-factor authentication for all administrative access (IS-010 s2; failure on Confidential data => HIGH security risk, IS-010 s8)
Privileged access role-based, logged and reviewed; no shared administrator accounts (IS-010 s2)
Confidential/Restricted data encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2+ and at rest with industry-standard cryptography (IS-010 s3; failure => HIGH, IS-010 s8)
Security-relevant events logged (IS-010 s4)
Confirmed security incidents affecting NFS data notified without undue delay and no later than 24 hours after confirmation (IS-010 s4)
Critical internet-facing vulnerabilities remediated within 7 calendar days; high within 30 days (IS-010 s5)
Generative AI processing Confidential data: prompts, uploaded content and outputs not retained for provider model training (IS-010 s6; failure => HIGH, IS-010 s8)
Operational retention of Confidential GenAI content no longer than 7 days unless business justification and Information Security approval are documented (IS-010 s6; failure => HIGH, IS-010 s8)
Current subprocessor list maintained and NFS notified before material subprocessor changes (IS-010 s7)
Security questionnaire completed with evidence of security controls (e.g. certification reports) (PR-001 s3)
Approval chain matching the annual contract value: above EUR 100,000 requires Business owner, Procurement, Finance and Technology Investment Committee (PR-001 s2)
Purchases above EUR 50,000 include at least three comparable offers, or a written single-source justification by Procurement (PR-001 s5)
Material pricing and contractual commitments traceable to cited source documents; total cost reflects the configuration needed to meet policy (PR-001 s6)
Vendors processing Confidential or Restricted information obtain Information Security approval before contract signature (PR-001 s3)
Confidential data: enterprise contractual protections, including no provider training on NFS content and approved retention (DC-002 s5)
Restricted data not submitted to external generative AI services unless a written CISO and Legal exception exists (DC-002 s4, s5)
Subprocessors subject to security and confidentiality obligations equivalent to the vendor's (IS-010 s7)
Contractual incident-notification commitment consistent with the 24-hour requirement (IS-010 s4)
Any policy exception approved in writing by the Head of Procurement and the accountable risk owner (PR-001 s7)
AI Governance review with documented intended use, affected users, data categories, expected benefits, material risks and human oversight (PR-001 s4)
AI risk tier determined; systems processing Confidential/Restricted information are High risk (AI-004 s2)

High-risk AI controls: named business owner, documented evaluation, human review of consequential outputs, audit logging, security review, privacy review where personal data is involved, rollback or suspension mechanism (AI-004 s3)
Final approval of a High-risk AI vendor by authorized human approvers, never solely an automated recommendation (AI-004 s6; PR-001 s4)
